Welcome to SKS Veterinary Hospital! With over 22 years of trusted care and 14 branches, we've successfully performed 50,000+ surgeries and cared for over 500,000 happy pets. We are India's leading multi-specialty veterinary hospital dedicated to your pet's health and happiness.

Subscribe for expert pet care advice, heartwarming stories, and the latest updates from our experienced veterinarians. Whether you own a dog, or a cat, our channel delivers valuable tips, preventive care, and insights to help your pet live a healthier, happier life.

Join the SKS Veterinary Hospital family and get the best in veterinary care. Visit our website or contact us anytime!
